questions.question: A run is tagged champion. What does that establish?
options: It is automatically deployed and monitored.
A registry alias points to that version; deployment and acceptance need their own evidence.
Its validation set is now an untouched test set.
questions.explanation: An alias points to a registered model version. It does not deploy that version or approve its quality. Resolve the alias to a version and artifact identity, then verify the actual runtime loads and evaluates that artifact.
optionFeedback: An alias is a registry pointer. Deployment still needs an explicit artifact selection, loading and target prediction check.
